;Armed conflicts and attacks
*In Pakistan three [[Suicide attack|suicide bombers]] attempted to storm a police housing complex in the southern [[Balochistan]] province. One of them was killed by guards, while the two others entered and blew themselves up, killing a senior constable and wounding five others. The [[Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan|Pakistani Taliban]] has claimed responsibility [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-attack/one-killed-as-militants-attack-pakistan-police-housing-complex-idUSKCN1TR0ML (Reuters)]
*[[International military intervention against ISIL]]
**[[Canada and the Iraq War]]
***Defence Minister [[Harjit Sajjan]] announces that Canada will continue to command a [[NATO]] mission in [[Iraq]] for a second year until November 2020. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/06/26/Canada-s-command-of-NATO-mission-in-Iraq-extended-to-late-2020-.html (Al Arabiya)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Two U.S. Troops are killed in an [[Ambush|ambush]] by the [[Taliban]] in [[Maidan Wardak Province|Wardak Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/06/26/aghan-war-2-u-s-service-members-killed-possible-taliban-ambush/1569137001/ (''USA Today'')]
*Four men with ties to [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] are arrested in [[Nicaragua]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48773780 (BBC News)]

;Arts and culture 
*[[LGBT in the United States]] 
**[[New York City]] begins the [[Stonewall 50 – WorldPride NYC 2019|50th Annual World Pride festival]], expecting to draw four million people over six days. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190625-50-years-after-stonewall-new-york-stages-huge-gay-pride-rally (France 24)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least ten illegal migrants are killed after a vehicle lost control in [[Edirne]], [[Turkey]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-06/26/c_138175635.htm (Xinhua)]

;International relations
*[[Germany–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] states that Germany is "delinquent" on NATO defense, saying, "So they are giving Russia billions of dollars yet we are supposed to protect Germany and Germany is delinquent! Okay?" [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2019/06/26/Trump-says-Germany-is-delinquent-on-NATO-defense.html (Al Arabiya)]

;Law and crime
*An unnamed [[Brazilian Air Force]] sergeant is arrested in [[Seville]] for smuggling 39 kilograms of [[cocaine]] inside an [[Embraer E-Jet family|Embraer E190]] airliner. The aircraft, now grounded, was being used as a backup plane during [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro|Bolsonaro]]'s official visit to [[Japan]], connecting in the [[Spain|Spanish]] city. [https://www.theolivepress.es/spain-news/2019/06/26/brazilian-soldier-from-convoy-of-president-bolsonaro-arrested-for-smuggling-cocaine-into-spains-sevilla-after-controversial-leader-vowed-to-crack-down-on-drugs/ (''The Olive Press'')]
*In a unanimous decision, the [[Supreme Court of Japan]] rejects retrial for a 92-year-old woman, Ayako Haraguchi, who had already served 10 years in prison for the 1979 murder of her former brother-in-law. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2019/06/26/national/crime-legal/supreme-court-rejects-retrial-92-yr-old-woman-1979-murder/#.XRPDcuhKjcc (''The Japan Times'')]
*[[Terrorism in Canada]]
**[[Canada]]'s government adds [[Neo-Nazism|Neo-Nazi]] groups [[Blood & Honour]] and [[Combat 18]] to its list of designated terrorist organizations. It is the first time that extreme [[Far-right politics|far-right]] groups have been designated as terrorist in Canada. Three [[Shia Islam|Shia]] militant groups, including the [[Iran]]ian-backed [[Al-Ashtar Brigades]] are also banned. [https://globalnews.ca/news/5432851/canada-adds-neo-nazi-groups-blood-honour-and-combat-18-to-list-of-terror-organizations/ (Global News)]
